features.metric: accuracy by all four quantity ratios; A/B pooled without naming visual conditions
features.unit: human participant x timepoint x ratio; model seed x supplied input pair
features.model: supplied scalar encodes order; encoder and spacing controls already evaluated
features.difference: human visual extraction versus supplied n/8; unknown A/B meaning and stimulus metadata
features.unlock: fixed visual-condition codebook, matched stimulus descriptors and prospectively registered matched task

features.metric: pre/post observed accuracy change; trialwise learning curve only when actual trial data exist
features.unit: human participant pre/post summary or original trial; computational seed learning trajectory
features.model: actual trial rewards plus fixed-probe expected choice probability; acquisition criteria retained
features.difference: observed response proportion differs from expected policy probability; queries and feedback schedules differ
features.unlock: verified task version, matched exposure/feedback schedule and separate acquisition criterion

features.metric: held-out cases conditional on prior acquisition; task transfer distinct from same-task change
features.unit: human participant across tasks; computational seed x untouched input split
features.model: nuisance OOD and supplied-quantity probes; no demonstrated discovery of mathematical sequence rules
features.difference: supplied order and arbitrary label symmetry constrain transfer; numerical symbols are artificial model inputs
features.unlock: verified group labels, independent task splits, acquisition gate and equivalent transfer contrast

features.metric: pre/post-reversal response and acquisition-qualified adaptation; conditional stay/switch is descriptive
features.unit: human original adjacent trial pair nested within person; seed trajectory with one reversal
features.model: probabilistic acquisition and reversal failures preserved; fixed/plastic/rewired/ANN controls
features.difference: multiple human reversals, information requests, shared replayed schedules and losses versus one model reversal and binary rewards
features.unlock: exact historical execution evidence or new verified public task; matched state/exposure/resource design and identifiable metric

features.metric: A performance after B relative to exposure-matched A-only control with acquisition fixed
features.unit: participant or seed nested within an explicitly counterbalanced task sequence
features.model: reversal/history interventions exist; no matched human two-rule interference design
features.difference: reversal cost cannot alone separate interference, confidence, output weights and activity
features.unlock: public A-to-B/B-to-A and single-task controls with verified semantics and prospective acquisition gates

features.metric: A-to-B versus B-to-A with equal exposure, initial state and acquisition control
features.unit: participant or seed assigned to a task order; repeated windows are not independent subjects
features.model: history and head attenuation effects investigated; no complete matched order comparison
features.difference: a computational reset is not natural forgetting; seed counts are not fly animal counts
features.unlock: verified public counterbalanced order data plus matched model protocol, including time and interference controls

scope: evidence map and integer recount of prior verified measurement; no new rate pooling, significance, similarity or biological claim
